title: WORLD OF FINAL FANTASY MAXIMA
description: A colorful FINAL FANTASY crossover RPG where Lann and Reynn capture Mirages, build stacked battle formations, and meet familiar series characters in a storybook world. The twins travel into a miniature-styled world filled with familiar FINAL FANTASY creatures and characters. Additional champion transformations and systems expand the late-game options beyond the original release.

gameplayPillars.title: Mirage collection
gameplayPillars.description: Players capture creatures called Mirages and develop them through transformations and abilities.

gameplayPillars.title: Stack battle system
gameplayPillars.description: Small, medium, and large units can be stacked together, combining statistics and abilities into strategic formations.

gameplayPillars.title: FINAL FANTASY crossover cast
gameplayPillars.description: Famous heroes and creatures from across the series appear in stylized roles.

gameplayPillars.title: Maxima additions
gameplayPillars.description: The Maxima version adds Avatar Change and additional champions, Mirages, and features.

gameplayPillars.title: Classic command combat
gameplayPillars.description: Turn-based battles reward elemental weaknesses, status effects, and party composition.

storyChapters.title: Lann and Reynn enter Grymoire
storyChapters.body: The twins travel into a miniature-styled world filled with familiar FINAL FANTASY creatures and characters.

storyChapters.title: Collect Mirages
storyChapters.body: Progression revolves around capturing and developing monsters with different sizes and abilities.

storyChapters.title: Meet champions
storyChapters.body: Iconic FINAL FANTASY characters appear throughout the adventure and can influence combat.

storyChapters.title: Uncover the twins’ past
storyChapters.body: The story gradually reveals hidden memories and the larger conflict surrounding Grymoire.

storyChapters.title: Use Maxima content
storyChapters.body: Additional champion transformations and systems expand the late-game options beyond the original release.
